title: How Robert grew a $3,200 account selling SPX put spreads
summary: Robert Mintosh, a brand-new options trader (started March 2025), sells at-the-money SPX put credit spreads 10 points wide at 5-7 DTE, entered discretionarily on 20-EMA pullbacks and mostly held to expiry, and reports growing $3,200 to ~5x in ~4 months (self-reported ~50 trades, 71% win). The headline is a survivorship/leverage artifact: ATM (~50-delta) short spreads through a benign 2025 bull tape make 71% weekly wins mostly P(no drop) plus drift, not a demonstrated edge, and selling ATM is a directional bet on bull continuation dressed as income. Real virtues are defined risk (~$650 max loss, cash-settled SPX), an honest low-oversell presenter with no sales motive, and admitted failure modes (over-leverage, weak stops, ATM gamma held into expiry); thin ~$60/trade gross EV (65% break-even win rate) is regime-fragile. The mechanical skeleton is highly testable on SPX EOD data (the EMA-pullback timing and expiry-day intraday management are not). Write-up: strategies/robert_spx_put_spreads.md (conviction 2/5).
